Why integrative care matters

We believe health is a network: sleep, stress, digestion, environment, and relationships interact. Our clinician, {{PRACTITIONER_NAME}}, {{CREDENTIALS}}, combines conventional assessment with lifestyle and nutritional strategies to create an individualized, measurable plan. The goal is education, sustainable change, and improved function — not quick fixes.

Person-centered intake

Time to understand history, priorities, and patterns that shape symptoms.

Integrated planning

Treatment plans mix evidence-based modalities: nutrition, movement, mind-body, targeted supplements, and optional labs.

Ongoing support

Follow-ups to refine recommendations and track outcomes over weeks and months.

Our clinical framework

A structured, transparent pathway so you know what to expect at each step.

  1. 1. Intake & assessment

    Comprehensive history, focused exam, and review of prior testing.

  2. 2. Personalized plan

    Actionable goals across sleep, nutrition, movement, and stress resilience.

  3. 3. Optional labs & measurables

    Targeted testing when appropriate — explained as tools to guide care, not as mandatory steps.

  4. 4. Iteration & follow-up

    Regular check-ins to adjust interventions and celebrate progress.

Services — blended care options

We offer a hybrid model combining virtual visits and in-clinic appointments when needed, tailored to your goals and comfort.

Initial Comprehensive Visit

90–120 minute intake to establish priorities, review past tests, and set an initial plan.

Book an intake

Focused Follow-up

30–45 minute visits to adjust recommendations and review progress. Telehealth available.
